content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fresno

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's education and hours requirements to confirm you meet the credential's baseline qualifications before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's training program.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. You will attend interactive sessions delivered online, covering the PMBOK Guide framework and real-world project scenarios. Upon completion, you'll receive your 35 contact hours of formal education—a prerequisite for PMI application.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, create your PMI account and submit your official PMP application, documenting your education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee directly to PMI. Review your application status and wait for PMI's eligibility approval before scheduling your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Take the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, including practice tests and study guides, to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE. Sit for the computer-based PMP exam and receive your score immediately upon completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, maintain your PMP by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle. Participate in approved training, conferences, and volunteer activities. Renew your credential with PMI before expiration to keep your competitive advantage in Fresno's professional job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
